❯ what is 41 again

● #41 turns off the tool's "Update available! Update now" prompt, the one that failed with EACCES and started this whole thread. It adds check_for_update_on_startup = false to /etc/tool/managed_config.toml.

  The tool lives in the root-owned tool directory, so its own updater can never write there. The fleet playbook updates the tool instead, so the prompt only ever offers an option that fails. It's a 4-line change, and I
  tested it in tmux: with the setting the prompt is gone, without it the prompt is back.

  The fleet now runs main, which doesn't have this setting. So the 8:00 PM run will rewrite this machine's managed_config.toml without it, and the prompt will come back here too. Merging #41 is what keeps it off for
  everyone.

  It has no review yet. Should I send it to Copilot?
